tasks.label: Run Active File
tasks.command: $file = '${file}'; switch ('${fileExtname}'.ToLowerInvariant()) { '.py' { python "$file" } '.js' { node "$file" } '.ts' { npx tsx "$file" } '.html' { $directory = Split-Path -Parent $file; $basename = Split-Path -Leaf $file; $server = Start-Process -FilePath python -ArgumentList @('-m', 'http.server', '8765', '--directory', $directory) -PassThru; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1; Start-Process "http://127.0.0.1:8765/$basename"; Write-Output "Serving $file at http://127.0.0.1:8765/$basename (PID $($server.Id))" } '.ps1' { & "$file" } '.sh' { bash "$file" } '.bat' { & $env:ComSpec /c "$file" } default { Write-Error "Unsupported active file extension: ${fileExtname}"; exit 1 } }
